segments.text: Welcome to the Helsinki commute board. This sample-data walkthrough shows how to plan your journey.
Choose a nearby stop. The picker shows its name, code, and distance from the office.
Compare departures, countdowns, tram routes, and arrivals. Travel duration appears on the right. The first result highlights your next journey.
Route numbers distinguish the connections. The summary identifies direct journeys, transfers, or walking options.
Switch direction to plan the return trip. Your selected stop becomes the destination, with updated journey options.
Search for another stop by name. Here, we select the railway station from the results.
The browser remembers your stop and direction, ready for your next visit.
Refresh to request journeys again. The board also updates automatically every minute.
React powers the interface. The graph Q L server calls Digitransit, keeping your subscription key outside browser code.
The repository includes Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform for Azure, and observability configuration. This recording does not demonstrate a cloud deployment.
Explore the commute board repository on GitHub. These responses are simulated, not live schedules. Thank you for watching.
